name: AX30G Reverb -- four parallel feedback combs (tapped twice, once per output) into a per-channel Schroeder allpass cascade; High Damp resolved 2026-09-18
notes: Derivation: docs/rev-model-2026-09-18.md (structure, Rev Time, Balance, nulls) and docs/rev-highdamp-2026-09-18.md (the High Damp filter and Balance 20). This file supersedes models/ax30g-rev.json; the two differ ONLY in maps.high_damp + high_damp_scaling (per-comb poles), maps.balance_wet/balance_dry (the Balance 20 point and a re-measured dry column), and the removal of the per-Type high_damp_map tables.

Structure per Type: predelay -> a per-channel pure input delay -> FOUR parallel feedback combs (each a plain recirculating delay with a one-pole lowpass in its feedback when High Damp is up) -> each comb is read at ONE position per output channel, the four reads summed with equal weight -> a three-section series Schroeder allpass cascade, its own lengths per channel -> wet, inverted.

Every allpass is y[n] = u*v[n] + v[n-L] - u*y[n-L] (a Schroeder allpass with a NEGATIVE coefficient), the sign pattern the unit shows (+,+,-,+ along each element's own echo series). Sections whose LENGTH is shared between L and R also share u, to the measurement's 0.3 %.
comb read offsets are given in each channel's own frame, i.e. after input_delay[channel]; several exceed the comb's own length (PLATE), which a delay line longer than its feedback tap supplies.

Rev Time law: comb gain g_i = 10^(-3*rt_length_i/(RevTime*fs)) -- each comb's own RT60 IS the displayed Rev Time in seconds. rt_length equals the comb's delay for ROOM and HALL; for PLATE's two short combs it is twice the delay (measured: those two decay at exactly 2x the rate per sample that a common RT60 would give, and their High Damp poles scale with the same doubled length).

High Damp law (measured 2026-09-18, docs/rev-highdamp-2026-09-18.md): ONE first-order lowpass w[n] = (1-a)*y[n-d] + a*w[n-1] in each comb's feedback path, unity gain at DC, with a PER-COMB pole a_i = A(HighDamp) * rt_length_i / max_j(rt_length_j) and A(HighDamp) = 0.017373 * HighDamp (maps.high_damp is A, i.e. the pole of the comb with the longest rt_length). High Damp 0 is a = 0 exactly (measured flat to +-0.05 dB per pass from 125 Hz to 16 kHz). high_damp_scaling = 'rt_length' is what tells the renderer to scale.

Balance is a crossfade with two measured tables, nine points each (Balance 20 added 2026-09-18). The wet column is from pairwise nulls of the 1 kHz burst tail against the Balance 50 capture; the dry column is the rms of the burst's first 6.5 ms (dry only -- HALL's wet arrives at 10.4 ms) referred to the send channel.

resampler.half_mult 100 is set here; models/ax30g-rev.json is missing it (flagged by the REV C++ port, docs/rev-cpp-2026-09-18.md) and therefore ran at scipy's default 10. Measured 2026-09-18: it changes the burst and wet-tail nulls by 0.00 dB on every REV row tested and only improves the dry-click and sweep columns (-9.49 -> -11.27 dB and -22.86 -> -23.66 dB on the Balance 0 row), so every number in docs/rev-highdamp-2026-09-18.md stands; those two columns there were measured without the key.
